title: Summer '68
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Would you like to say something before you leave?
Perhaps you' care to state exactly how you feel.
We say goodbye before we've said hello.
I hardly even like you. I shouldn't care at all.
We met just six hours ago. The music was too loud.
From your bed I came today and lost bloody year.
And I would like to know, how do you feel?
How do feel?
Not single word was said. They lied still without fears.
Occasionally you showed smile, but what was the need?
I felt the cold far too soon in wind of ninety-five.
My friends are lying in the sun, I wish that I was there.
Tomorrow brings another town, another girl like you.
Have your time before you leave to greet another man just to let me know,
How do you feel?
How do you feel?
Goodbye to you.
A7sus2

[chorus]
I've had enough for one day.
